name: Pinggu

queries.query: Pinggu Beijing official cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: Official Beijing material identified a Beijing real-estate-registration and cadastral-map visualization service. Pinggu was one of the named pilot districts, but the service requires identity verification and no anonymous parcel feature service or polygon response was found.

queries.result: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会 sources identify the Pinggu District Real Estate Registration Center as the local institution responsible for registration, land cadastral/right-boundary survey, cadastral data and archives. Official notices describe cadastral maps and land-unit codes, but no anonymous parcel geometry/API response was verified.

requests.outcome: Timed out after 20 seconds with normal TLS/HTTP handling; no login, identity verification, or retry with certificate bypass was attempted.
Official page was readable through search results and confirmed Pinggu pilot cadastral-map visualization; no parcel geometry returned.
Official Pinggu organizational page was readable through search results and confirmed the local cadastral/registration custodian; no public API returned.

registryBasis: Local registry/cadastre custodian is directly evidenced by the official Pinggu branch organizational page naming the Pinggu District Real Estate Registration Center and its cadastral responsibilities. This is distinct from the general Beijing municipal visualization service.
